description: Hunting tutorial: the Digimon to catch is Agumon (species 0x22) instead of Koromon (species 0x15). Species ids are the db_txt_list name index + 8 (0-7 are eggs), so Koromon = 13 + 8, Agumon = 26 + 8. Found with Ghidra in overlay 0 (Hunting Tutorial), function 0x021216a4.

patches.comment: mov r2,#0x15 -> mov r2,#0x22: species argument of the bl 0x020618e8 that creates the tutorial Koromon
sub r3,r2,#0x16 -> mvn r3,#0: keep r3 = -1 now that r2 changed
